title: Natchez Trace Gateway Loft Apt GW5
description:
Hike/bike from this centrally located farmhouse minutes from Franklin. . Your lodging is the entire second floor of a large farmhouse. Private full kitchen, livingroom, and dining area. Organic farm right in front. Trail to creek and through forest starts at your back door!
Less than a mile from the Natchez Trace Bridge. Gateway to Big East Fork Valley & Timberland Park. All Fork Inn guests may visit Lake Gratitude and Pavillion located a short drive away.
Optional $100 pool fee covers chemical

The space
Private floor in large shared farmhouse.  Private full kitchen, livingroom, and dining area. Share outdoor porches with other guests.  Access to washer/dryer.

Guest access
Guests have access to all outside porches, washer/dryer, and shared outside pool ($100 fee covers cleaning and chemicals for 3 days). You may use pool until 9pm. Enjoy Greenhouses and wide shallow stream. Walk mountain trail over to the next valley on private hiking trail. Access 8-acre private lake, next to private farm a short car ride away.

We are the proud owners of The Fork Inn in 3000 acre Big East Fork Valley. We are in a protected watershed located 19 miles west of Nashville and 10 miles north of Franklin. 

We are honored to be Stewards of Big East Fork Valley and support the nearby Center for Sustainable Stewardship. We enjoy the abundant wildlife and the many nearby creeks and hiking trails.
